name_ja: Almaty M7.3 earthquake (Verny-type, Trans-Ili Alatau front)
desc_ja: Scenario: a M7.3 Verny-type earthquake on the Trans-Ili Alatau frontal fault zone just south of Almaty (the 1887 source area), at 10:40 on a weekday in late November. MSK IX-X in the foothill districts (Nauryzbay, Bostandyk, Medeu), IX in the centre and on the soft, water-saturated loess plain of the north (Almaly, Alatau, Zhetysu), VIII-IX in Auezov, Turksib and Talgar, VIII in Karasay, VII-VIII in Ile. Soviet-era brick and panel housing collapses, gas fires, loss of power, water and district heating with frost at night, and a M6.0 aftershock at 36 h. Intensities, exposure fractions and timings are assumptions built on the 2020-21 microzonation (whole city in the MSK 9-10 zone), the 2017-18 seismic certification (19% of floor area needs strengthening, 12% slated for demolition) and the January 2024 M7.0 reaction (mass night-time egress into the cold).
t0_ja: t=0: Thursday 19 Nov 2026, 10:40 local (+05:00), M7.3 main shock (assumed)
agency_ja: Institute of Seismology (Almaty) / Ministry of Emergency Situations
kpi_dead_note_ja: Refs: 1887 Verny 332 dead, 1911 Kemin 452 dead (city then under 50k); Amey et al. 2021: 4,100 +/- 3,500 deaths for a M6.5 under today's city; experts: up to 30% of buildings destroyed at MSK IX-X. Rate 0.003 assumed; demo model
assumptions_ja: District populations: 2021 census district counts (citypopulation.de) scaled x1.123 to the 2024-11-01 city total of 2,280,296 (stat.gov.kz); Talgar 265k (akim, 2025); Karasay and Ile grown from 2013 census figures (assumed).
jp = expatriate residents per district: no published figure; values are order-of-magnitude assumptions concentrated in Medeu (Samal, Dostyk), Bostandyk (Koktem, Esentai) and Almaly.

Exposure fractions follow the assumed MSK intensity by district (foothill source zone vs loess/high-groundwater north) and building stock (self-built, 1950s-70s brick, large-panel, modern RC); no official microzonation polygons were available.
fatality_rate 0.003 sits between the historical city tolls (1887: 332; 1911: 452) and Amey et al. 2021 (4,100 +/- 3,500 for a M6.5 under the city); the model total is a demo, not a forecast.

Shelter capacities, utility restoration times, logistics states, supply stocks, company sites (staff, locations) and all t-values are assumptions; the real references are the 2024-01-23 reaction (384 reception points opened within 1-1.5 h, some closed), the 2024-03-04 metro inspection (5 h) and MES mobilization plans (55,000 personnel).

supply_note_ja: Cold-season earthquake: the first 24 h are dominated by trauma kits, search-and-rescue and blankets (frost at night), from 48 h by winterized tents, heaters, hygiene kits and water. Demand = evacuees x per-person rate; supply = stock plus an arrival curve. All stocks and lead times are assumptions; references: MES plan to mobilize 55,000 personnel and 9,000 equipment units within 24-72 h, and relief items reaching the January 2024 epicentre within about 12 h.

actions.ja: Drop, cover, hold; then evacuate by the stairs to Esentai Park; roll call; triage injuries
actions.why: Aftershocks and falling facade glass; never use elevators (2024: injuries from running out and jumping)

actions.ja: Start safety confirmation by SMS, messenger and satellite phone; avoid voice calls
actions.why: Network congestion; official mass alerts can lag 1-3 h

actions.ja: Shut off gas and power in the office and staff flats where safe; bring families down from high-rise flats to assembly points
actions.why: No automatic gas shut-off in Almaty; fire risk from broken risers

actions.ja: Issue warm clothing, blankets and hot drinks; move infants, elderly and the injured to heated reception points before dark (about 17:30)
actions.why: Frost at night in late November; hypothermia risk outdoors or in cars

actions.ja: Keep the tower closed; book a structural inspection; no re-entry for belongings
actions.why: Looking intact is not structural safety; a M6 aftershock is expected

actions.ja: Route water, trauma kits and blankets to Alatau and Nauryzbay through the Red Crescent
actions.why: Lowest-income districts with the most collapses; reception points over capacity

actions.ja: Activate the BCP: dispatch from the Khorgos hub and work remotely; declare the warehouse down
actions.why: Warehouse racking collapsed; the A3 / Khorgos corridor reopens first

actions.ja: Survey staff on relocation or temporary leave; coordinate lists with the consular office
actions.why: Commercial flights at ALA expected from about 60 h

actions.ja: Set up a temporary office; arrange counselling for staff and children
actions.why: Aftershocks continue 2-4 weeks; tower closed for weeks

actions.ja: Move to recovery: staff housing checks, school reopening, insurance claims, warehouse repair plan

timeline.ja: M7.3 at 10:40 local, epicentre in the Trans-Ili Alatau foothills 15-20 km south of the centre; MSK IX-X
Sirens and Mass Alert SMS; residents told to leave buildings for open areas and switch off gas
All 85 staff down the stairs to Esentai Park; 3 minor injuries; roll call under way
Operational HQ opened; civil protection at highest readiness; 112 lines overloaded
Safety confirmation started via SMS and satellite; 48% of staff reached in the first hour
384 school reception points ordered open; first points admitting people (2024 practice: 1-1.5 h)
National emergency declared for Almaty and Almaty Region; MES mobilizing up to 55,000 personnel
Power out across the city; priority restoration to hospitals, water intakes and the airport

advice_ja: Frost at night: do not sleep outdoors or in unheated gyms without blankets; move infants, elderly and the injured to heated reception points before dark
